assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_seat_lev_kamenev
assets.title: 列夫·加米涅夫

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_seat_ivan_smirnov
assets.title: 伊万·斯米尔诺夫
assets.description: **首任**邮电人民委员 / 西伯利亚革命委员会主席

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_seat_leonid_serebryakov
assets.title: 列昂尼德·谢列布里亚科夫
assets.description: 中央书记处书记 / 公路与汽车运输总局局长 / **车工出身**

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_build_the_red_army
assets.title: 缔造红军
assets.description: 这辆军用专列曾经是他的战地指挥部。在那决定命运的 3 年里，他乘坐这辆专列沿着 8000 公里的前线行进，哪里危险就冲向哪里，只有短暂的磋商或者出席莫斯科的公众集会才暂时打断他的行程。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_military_specialists
assets.title: 返聘沙俄军官
assets.description: 1919 年初，他断然反对逮捕查京将军。他写道，查京帮助苏维埃所做的工作比那些关押他的人还多，蛮横地对待这样的人则会对军官的士气具有灾难性的影响。他要求释放将军，并愿在法庭给他定罪前亲自为他作保。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_against_partisan_warfare
assets.title: 反对游击主义
assets.description: 正如托洛茨基所指出的，游击战的混乱反映了革命下面的农民因素，而反对它的斗争同样是为了支持无产阶级国家组织，以抵制正在瓦解它的元素化的小资产阶级无政府状态。绝大部分的军队新兵都是农民，整个国家是一片起义的农民海洋，对于这种战争方式，他们不仅有着传统，而且本能地适应。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_uneven_and_combined_development
assets.title: 不平衡与综合发展律
assets.description: 在一些情况下，从一开始就领先者可以加强其领先地位，而在另一些情况下，同样地由于发展的步调不同，一些落后者可以赶上甚至超过那些先前享有优势者。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_permanent_revolution
assets.title: 不断革命论
assets.description: 在狱中，他完成了对俄国革命的见解——不断革命论。认为俄国的民主革命必然要由工人阶级来领导，以无产阶级专政来完成，并由此发展成社会主义革命。其奠基性的表述最初出自马克思，1906 年由托洛茨基针对俄国的情况重新加以表述，随后又在 1928 年进一步阐发。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_socialism_in_one_country
assets.title: 驳「一国社会主义」
assets.description: 斯大林的一国社会主义论，被他斥为放弃世界革命的借口。1926 年，他与昔日的对手季诺维也夫、加米涅夫联手组成联合反对派，主张党内民主与经济计划化，谴责领导层对资产阶级分子的让步。这场争论持续了约 18 个月。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_the_new_course
assets.title: 新方针
assets.description: 1923 年 10 月，他致信中央委员会提出广泛批评，特别强调党内民主遭到破坏、经济计划化不足。改革被承诺了，他随即以一封公开信详细说明改革应取的方向。而此后党组织在压制它的主要批评者时，其猛烈和狂怒在党内反对派的漫长历史上是前所未有的。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_against_the_bureaucracy
assets.title: 反对官僚化
assets.description: 无产阶级专政将通过政党夺取政权而建立，托洛茨基认为这个政党在革命中起领导作用。但是，他警告说，一旦它的任务完成，这样的党要提防用自身代替无产阶级或是支配无产阶级。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_limited_market_reforms
assets.title: 有限市场化
assets.description: 内战结束后，他把注意力转向俄国的经济重建。他首先提议放松战时共产主义严苛的集中制，允许市场力量运作。这个提议被否决之后，他才转而尝试把军事纪律应用于经济。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_labour_armies
assets.title: 劳动军
assets.description: 他转而尝试把军事纪律应用于经济：把士兵用作劳动军，并试图把交通运输系统的管理军事化。这个方向同样被党的十大否决，此后连他自己也不再主张它。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_state_planning
assets.title: 经济计划化
assets.description: 他要求扩大国家计划委员会的权力，而李可夫和索柯里尼柯夫则怀疑计划性，公开指责他之所以要求扩大国家计划委员会的权力只是因为他觊觎它的领导权。他所作的报告和所提交的『提纲』是苏联经济史上最关键的文件，他在其中描绘了今后几十年的苏联经济远景。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_accelerated_industrialization
assets.title: 加速工业化
assets.description: 国家的大粮库有一半已见了底，城市居民面临着饥饿的威胁，连军队的给养都不充足，面包店外排着长队，面包价格不断上涨。正是在这样的处境下，联合反对派要求加快工业化、反对向富农让步。1928 年，斯大林开始了第一个五年计划。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_the_comintern_manifesto
assets.title: 共产国际宣言
assets.description: 1919 年 3 月，他与列宁共同创立第三国际，并撰写了它的首篇宣言。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_the_chinese_question
assets.title: 中国革命问题
assets.description: 1927 年春天，党内斗争的火焰又一次燃烧起来。这次斗争是同到那时之前从未提出过的一个问题相联系的，但从此以后这个问题却自始至终都是斗争的中心，直到联合反对派最终被开除出党并解体为止。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_united_front
assets.title: 反法西斯统一战线
assets.description: 第三国际不顾托洛茨基自 1930 年以来不断的警告，大大低估了纳粹党的危险性，同时拒绝社会民主党建立统一战线对抗纳粹，结果使德国工人阶级的组织毫无抵抗地被粉碎，并使法西斯势力横行十余年。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_the_permanent_revolutionary
assets.title: 永久的革命者
assets.description: 要求我放弃政治活动，意味着要求我放弃为全世界工人阶级利益而进行的斗争，而这一斗争我已孜孜不倦地进行了 32 年之久，也就是我自觉生命的全部时间。只有腐朽透顶的官僚集团才会要求做出这种放弃，只有卑鄙的叛徒才能做出这种承诺。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_trotsky_the_builder_of_the_state
assets.title: 国家建设者
assets.description: 请告诉我还有哪个人能在一年之内建立起一支堪称模范的军队而且赢得军事专家的尊重；我们有这样的人，就有了一切，我们将创造出奇迹。

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_economics_of_transition
assets.title: 过渡时期的经济
assets.concept: An ivory sculpted bridge linking a wheat field on the left to a compact factory on the right, unfinished final bridge segment being fitted, strong simple silhouettes. Transition and connection between agriculture and industry.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_nep_is_not_a_retreat
assets.title: 新经济政策不是退却
assets.concept: A bold ivory road arrow sweeping FORWARD and upward, flanked by a simple worker's hammer and a sheaf of wheat, unity moving forward, no soldiers or human figures.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_abolish_the_tribute
assets.title: 取消「贡款」
assets.concept: A large broken tax-collection seal beside a completely BLANK folded requisition paper, a snapped rope around a wheat sheaf in foreground. Controlled confrontational symbolism, no readable marks on seal/paper, no money.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_alliance_is_the_axis
assets.title: 工农联盟是轴心
assets.concept: A central solid mechanical axle and wheel hub joining an ivory worker's hammer on left and a sheaf of wheat on right, radiating sturdy spokes. Clear axis/union imagery, no handshake.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_enrich_yourselves
assets.title: 发财吧
assets.concept: An abundant ivory grain barn with open doors full of harvested wheat sheaves, one simple hand plough in foreground. Productive rural prosperity. Absolutely NO coins, money, currency, numbers or lettering.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_proportional_development
assets.title: 按比例发展
assets.concept: Two equal-sized ivory intermeshing industrial gears, one enclosing a small wheat relief and the other a factory relief, measured balanced growth, a drafting divider below them. Not a weighing scale.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_cooperatives_into_the_system
assets.title: 合作社长入
assets.concept: Three small ivory rural cooperative houses linked by broad converging channels to a larger three-column institutional bank building behind, integration into a shared system, readable bold architectural silhouettes. No currency or coins.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_left_communism
assets.title: 左翼共产主义
assets.concept: A DARKER gunmetal sword and agricultural plough facing in opposition across a sharp jagged divide; small single upward assault arrow behind. Ominous compressed shield-shaped deep burgundy backing, tarnished restrained bronze laurel, much darker than other icons, stern alternate path. No blood, people, text or real-world hate symbols.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_bukharin_socialism_in_one_country
assets.title: 一国建成社会主义
assets.concept: A complete self-contained ivory sculpted industrial-agricultural state: broad factory and new buildings rising within a continuous enclosing boundary, wheat and compact turbine in foreground, cohesive completed construction. Most full and ceremonial composition in series, dense but legible, not a globe and not a turtle.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_rykov_supreme_economic_council
assets.title: 最高国民经济委员会主席
assets.concept: A monumental industrial council building facade integrated with a blast furnace and factory chimneys, resting on a large cogwheel. Clear solid architectural relief, the administrative organization of industry. No portrait.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_rykov_food_supply_commissar
assets.title: 劳动国防委员会粮秣特派员
assets.concept: A steam freight locomotive on rails coming diagonally forward, beside two large grain sacks and one supply crate, continuous supply route from warehouse to front. Logistics not combat, no soldiers or weapons firing.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_rykov_labour_defence_council
assets.title: 劳动与国防委员会副主席
assets.concept: Central distinctive emblem: a single ivory gear interlocked with a plain military shield. Below it a compact administrative desk bearing a blank folded planning map and two file folders. Tightly organized industrial and defence coordination, sober and practical.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_rykov_sponsor_aviation
assets.title: 扶植航空
assets.concept: A large early 1920s single-engine biplane with two clearly separated wings, fixed landing gear and propeller, diagonally ascending above a drafting compass and small blank engineering blueprint. Ivory relief aircraft, optimistic brighter highlights, no letters or numbers on aircraft, no jets.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_rykov_labour_defence_chair
assets.title: 劳动与国防委员会主席
assets.concept: The complete culmination of economic coordination. Reuse the SAME central ivory gear interlocked with plain military shield emblem from the vice-chair design. Enlarge and elevate it above a panoramic dispatch planning table. Surround its lower half with a unified compact chain of factory buildings on left, steam freight train below, early biplane on right, connected by a closed circular transport loop. Fullest composition in series yet readable at tiny size, a complete organized industrial transport defence system.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_found_the_comintern
assets.title: 缔造第三国际
assets.concept: A solemn symmetrical international congress: globe above a central lectern, a founding gavel prominently across its base, semicircle of delegate busts and several plain striped flags behind. Creation of a world organization, balanced ceremonial architecture.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_twenty_one_conditions
assets.title: 加入共产国际的条件
assets.concept: A large blank charter with geometric check marks but NO writing, a wax seal and stamp before a formal stone gateway; a small globe crowning the gateway establishes international membership conditions. Bold simple document and threshold silhouettes.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_social_fascism
assets.title: 社会法西斯主义
assets.concept: Historical strategy-game illustration of political division, not endorsement: two parallel blank folded banners anchored to one cold iron pedestal, a deep diagonal fissure separates them from a smaller opposing red banner; subtle Europe map relief behind. Cold dark steel relief and muted bronze frame, crimson backing retained, hardest shadows in the series. No extremist insignia, no swastikas, no text.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_bolshevization
assets.title: 布尔什维克化
assets.concept: An international organizational hierarchy: a large globe-backed central star seal linked by thick rigid branching lines to three matching smaller star medallions below, with a matching metal casting die at base. Uniform party organization across nations, orderly and disciplined, not an industrial factory scene.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_congress_of_the_east
assets.title: 东方各民族代表大会
assets.concept: Three dignified congress delegate busts in early twentieth-century clothing, including a Central Asian turban, Caucasian fur cap and plain worker cap, above a relief map of Eurasia and a large compass needle pointing east to the right. International congress in Baku, varied faces, no caricature. Warm ivory sculpted relief, geographic horizon.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_workers_united_front
assets.title: 工人统一战线
assets.concept: Three distinct streams of small worker silhouettes with differently patterned blank banners converge into one broad forward procession, with a large joined-hands relief at center and faint globe behind. Unity in practical action across national boundaries, flowing composition.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_speed_and_route
assets.title: 革命的速度与路线
assets.concept: An unfolded relief map of Europe and Asia with two bold branching curved route arrows taking different paths, beneath a large navigational compass. One path bends away from central Europe toward the east, no labels. Geographic strategic reassessment, more complete layered composition.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_party_in_revolution
assets.title: 党在无产阶级革命中的作用
assets.concept: Three prominent worker figures leading at the front, rows of smaller workers behind them, with one guiding star above and three small plain international banners. Organized vanguard and rank-and-file, no weapons, neutral ivory stone relief, large clear human silhouettes.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_trade_unions
assets.title: 论工会的作用
assets.concept: A wide factory assembly gateway embraced by a large gear, five worker figures gathering through its open center beneath two plain union banners, small globe medallion overhead. Organized workers as a collective, emphasize people and assembly rather than chimneys.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_monolithic_international
assets.title: 铁板一块的国际
assets.concept: ENDPOINT PAIR design skeleton: centered large globe at upper middle, six national blank flagpoles radiating behind globe, below globe a monumental two-pillar gateway, workers filling lower third, shared golden wreath red star and blank ribbon. COLD VERSION: blue-grey iron globe and gateway, tightly packed perfectly straight aligned worker ranks, stiff closely bundled flags, narrow closed-looking central passage, dense hard-edged unity, dark burgundy backing and muted antique gold. Full authoritative composition, no weapons.

assets.name: GFX_hof_ic_zinovyev_mass_international
assets.title: 群众的国际
assets.concept: ENDPOINT PAIR: reproduce image 2 composition skeleton and positions: same central globe upper middle, six flagpoles fanned behind globe, same two-pillar gateway below globe, worker crowd lower third, identical wreath/star/ribbon outer frame. WARM OPEN VERSION: warm ivory and pale bronze rather than cold iron, gateway with broad open passage, spaced flowing streams of workers joining from left and right, unfurled gently waving flags. More breathing space and movement, crimson red backing. Equal monumental importance and quality, not weaker. No text or weapons.

integration: art textures delivered; no script edits
